messages:
Nadia (CSM): Starting Harborlane pilot onboarding thread. Goal: 14-day pilot, focus on semantic search + chat assistants for support docs. Primary success signals: adoption by 3 CS reps, 80%+ satisfaction on spot-checks, and consistent latency under 600ms.
Theo (Sales): They signed at enterprise pilot tier; procurement needs an estimate for pilot costs.
Rina (Harborlane PM): Hi team, I'm the day-to-day PM. Omar will handle infra. Main blocker: our security team needs an audit trail and may require an on-prem option later.
Carlos (Solutions): Noted. We'll provide audit/logging options and an ingest checklist. Quick question: do you have a canonical doc store (S3/Confluence)?
Rina (Harborlane PM): S3 + Zendesk articles. We'll export a sandbox bundle ~8k docs.
Omar (Harborlane Infra): We'll need IP allowlist and a service account. Can you confirm the minimum TLS ciphers and our SIEM integration details?
Nadia (CSM): Action: Omar to share allowlist + SIEM webhook by EOD day 1. Carlos to prepare ingest script and mapping. Mona to schedule two enablement sessions (rep training + admin).
Mona (Enablement): I'll set up a 60-min training on Day 6 and a 30-min admin ops session on Day 3. Who should attend from Harborlane?
Rina (Harborlane PM): CS reps Amy, Raj, and Mei for the Day 6 session. Omar + one security engineer for Day 3.
Carlos (Solutions): Ingest format: JSONL with id, body, source, created_at, and optional metadata.tags. I'll post an example and a small CLI tool.
Carlos (Solutions): Example snippet: ```
cat docs.jsonl | curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/ingest \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/jsonl" --data-binary @-```
Nadia (CSM): Success criteria draft: 1) 3 reps use assistant in at least 5 real interactions each; 2) median retrieval relevance >= 0.7 on eval queries; 3) <3% failed calls. Add adoption metric to dashboard.
Theo (Sales): Also record NPS-style feedback after rep interactions; procurement will want qualitative notes.
Onboarding Bot: Onboard board created: https://redwood.company/onboard/harborlane-pilot (team-only).
Infra Bot: Network request created (ticket #NET-4821).
Omar (Harborlane Infra): Submitted allowlist + service account details in the doc. Confirming SIEM endpoint: https://siem.harborlane.internal/hook-llm.
Carlos (Solutions): Got it. We'll wire audit logs to that endpoint and include token/session IDs.
Mona (Enablement): Scheduling invites sent for Day 3 admin ops and Day 6 rep training.
Rina (Harborlane PM): Procurement asked for a simple cost breakdown for the 2-week pilot (approx hours, estimated token volume). Can someone draft?
Nadia (CSM): Ben (Finance) isn't in thread—I'll loop him in after we post a rough calc. For now, quick estimate: small Dedicated slot ~ $X/hr + token estimate; will put an ATTACH in the doc.
Carlos (Solutions): Risk note: if retrieval relevance is low we'll try reranking + larger context windows, but that may affect latency. We'll include fallback to hosted baseline model for critical flows.
Theo (Sales): Renewal risk: medium if adoption <50% of target or if integrations are delayed >5 business days. Let's plan a Day 10 exec demo to keep momentum.
Nadia (CSM): Scheduling Day 10 exec demo now. Also scheduling a mid-pilot check (Day 8) to review metrics and open issues.
Rina (Harborlane PM): Appreciate it. We'll provide a curated eval set (20 queries) and a sample of real tickets for spot-check.
Carlos (Solutions): Please include expected answers for the 20 queries so we can score recall/precision.
Nadia (CSM): Action list recap (owners + due dates): Omar: allowlist + SIEM (day 1). Carlos: ingest script + example (day 2). Mona: training invites (day 2). Ben/Finance: cost calc (day 3). Team: ingest + index (day 5). Day 6: rep training. Day 8: mid-pilot review. Day 10: exec demo. Final day 14: go/no-go.
Omar (Harborlane Infra): All set on allowlist. Posted details and pem for service account.
Onboarding Bot: Reminder: Day 8 mid-pilot review scheduled.
Nadia (CSM): Thanks all. Please post blockers here; I'll keep the onboarding doc updated with links and checklist. :sparkles:
